title: Romantic Bali Getaway with Sunset Cruise
alt: Sunset over the sea off Tanjung Benoa, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu and Tanjung Benoa
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Temple tour with the monkey forest
activities.description: A private day among the temples, taking in Taman Ayun, the Alas Kedaton monkey forest and the cliff top temple at Uluwatu.

activities.name: Water sports at Tanjung Benoa
activities.description: A half day combo at Tanjung Benoa with banana boat, jet ski and parasailing, all with life jackets and an instructor in the water.

activities.name: Sunset dinner cruise
activities.description: A half day cruise out of Benoa harbour with dinner on board and live music, timed for sunset over the Bukit peninsula.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the south coast, with a private temple day, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and a sunset cruise with dinner on the water.

stops.name: Seminyak
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Pool hotel a few minutes from Seminyak beach

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage for both of you on your first afternoon in Seminyak, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a private spa.

activities.name: Seminyak beach and Eat Street
activities.description: The long grey sand beach with its beach clubs, and the restaurants of Jalan Kayu Aya a short walk inland for a slow dinner.

program.name: Seminyak
program.description: Two quiet nights in Seminyak to finish, with a couples massage on arrival and a private candlelight dinner on the last evening.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Kuta hotel near the beach
First evening free on the south coast
Optional: the Kuta night market or a walk on the sand
2: Breakfast, then a private day among the temples
Taman Ayun and the Alas Kedaton monkey forest
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs in the late afternoon
Optional: the Kecak fire dance at the temple
3: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing with an instructor
Sunset cruise out of Benoa harbour in the evening
Dinner and live music on board as the light goes
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to Seminyak
Check in and a traditional Balinese massage for two
Optional: dinner along Eat Street or Jalan Laksmana
5: Breakfast and a full day free in Seminyak
Optional: a beach club afternoon or the Nyaman gallery
Candlelight dinner for two in the evening, set up privately
Optional: a late walk along Double Six beach
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Two beaches, two moods. Kuta for the activity, Seminyak for the dinners. Five nights, nothing rushed.
expert.tip: Book the sunset cruise for your second evening while you still have energy, and keep Seminyak for late starts. We can set the candlelight dinner on the sand if you prefer it to the hotel.

summary: Six days for two on the south coast: three nights in Kuta with a private temple day, water sports at Tanjung Benoa and a sunset dinner cruise, then two quieter nights in Seminyak with a couples massage and a candlelight dinner.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; private temple tour with the monkey forest and Uluwatu; water sports at Tanjung Benoa; sunset dinner cruise; Balinese massage for two; candlelight dinner.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
